objective.text: Select a fixed named route for Form Request failure redirection instead of relying on the Referer.

difficulty.rationale: Select a stable failure destination independently of the referring page.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A form can be submitted from several pages, but every HTML validation failure must redirect to the parameter-free named route profile.edit. Which Form Request configuration selects that route rather than the Referer?

options.rationale: The error bag controls message grouping, not the redirect destination.
options.misconception: The error bag controls message grouping, not the redirect destination.

options.rationale: redirect is treated as a URL/path destination, not a named-route lookup.
options.misconception: redirect is treated as a URL/path destination, not a named-route lookup.

options.rationale: redirectRoute is resolved through the URL generator as a route name when constructing the failure redirect.
Authorization decides permission; it is not a named failure-redirect selector.
options.misconception: Authorization decides permission; it is not a named failure-redirect selector.
